evidence.description: REQ-L1(iii) mandates `jq -c --argjson x <X> 'select(.requestId == $x)'` exact-field match and EXPLICITLY bans `grep '"requestId": <X>'` substring approach with rationale (ts/pass_id digit collision e.g. 5123100 inside 1782891234). Closes FIND-2-001 primary.
REQ-L1(iv) forces requestId serialization as str() in both task-request-map.jsonl and earnings.jsonl; mirror side casts to str before dedup/lookup. Closes FIND-2-001 numeric-vs-string sub-clause.
REQ-L1(ii) explicitly places map-append inside per-apply loop body and documents 1 tick → N map rows with shared CURRENT_PASS_ID + distinct requestId. Closes FIND-2-003 per-apply clarification.
REQ-L1(iii) states EARNED CHECK does NOT use CURRENT_PASS_ID (the current tick, unrelated to historical apply) — lookup-only via jq exact match. Closes FIND-2-003 EARNED CHECK sub-clause.

REQ-L1a discloses coarse-grain 1-to-N attribution, names monotone-max lossage of smaller settle in multi-settle-per-pass case, and defers per-application splitting to sprint-5. Closes FIND-2-003 coarse-grain disclosure requirement.

PROP-L1iii-exact-jq-match-no-substring: greps STARTUP diff for banned substring pattern = 0 hits AND asserts jq exact-match verbatim; fixture with requestId '5123' substring-appearing in another entry's ts proves collision is not a false match. Directly maps to REQ-L1(iii) + closes FIND-2-001.
PROP-L1ii-per-apply-not-per-tick: inspection asserts map-append call sits inside B2 per-apply loop body, not outside. Maps to REQ-L1(ii) + closes FIND-2-003.
PROP-E3-non-settled-and-zero-jpy-ignored rebound to EDGE-E3 (compound: non-settled OR zero-jpy) matching behavioral-spec.md:207. Closes FIND-2-002 half A.
PROP-E4-malformed-pass-id-fallback renamed + rebound to EDGE-E4 (malformed pass_id) matching behavioral-spec.md:208. Closes FIND-2-002 half B.
